text_block_list.text:
Today is the Osaka Hai, and Голд Сити
appears
unable to put her mind to the
race. She's unsure
whether she should
run in her feckless state.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's running without a goal, but she
won't allow
this to make her look like a
loser. Despite her
lack of enthusiasm,
she heads off to start the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
